title: Climate Change
seo_title: Grade 7 Science: Climate Change Worksheets (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: Earth's climate is changing, and human activities are a major cause: the greenhouse effect, evidence of climate change, and actions to reduce human impact. (summary of BC's Curriculum, Science 7, Earth and Space Science)
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 science worksheets (BC): the greenhouse effect, evidence for climate change, fossil fuels, human impact and ways to reduce it. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Extra greenhouse gases trap more heat.
key_sub: Burning fossil fuels adds carbon dioxide to the air.
body_html:
How to think about it

Greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide and methane trap heat near Earth's surface. This natural greenhouse effect keeps Earth warm enough for life. Burning coal, oil and gas adds more carbon dioxide, so more heat is trapped and the climate warms.

Evidence includes rising average temperatures, melting glaciers, rising sea levels and earlier springs. In BC, warmer and drier summers bring more wildfires. People can help by using renewable energy, walking or biking, and wasting less.

Example

Which gas from burning fuel is the main cause of climate change?

It is also breathed out by animals.

Answer: carbon dioxide

Example

Is the greenhouse effect bad?

Without it, Earth would be frozen.

Answer: no, but too much of it warms Earth

Common mistakes

  • Mixing up weather (day to day) and climate (over many years).
  • Thinking the ozone hole causes global warming.
  • Thinking one cold winter proves climate change is not happening.
